mechanisms: Fixed four-sample speed interval was too short at 240 FPS
Incoming speed was restricted to three selected contact samples
Strict monotonic intermediate observations rejected coherent noisy bounce legs
fixes: Choose the shortest clean observed interval with at least three observations and >=20 ms support
Use observed pre-contact history for incoming estimated speed; do not cross >75 ms gaps
Keep the original strict trajectory path and accept bounded regression support only as a fallback
Add localization residual to impact uncertainty when using noisy evidence
